parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters in the destination region.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description:
The name of the resource group.

> You can call the [DescribeDBResourceGroup](~~459446~~) operation to query the name of the resource group for a specific cluster.
